mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate indicates monetary easing, which can stimulate economic activity and lead to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 shows negative returns during a period of declining federal funds rates, this hypothesis is invalidated.

mechanism_narrative: A significant drop in the unemployment rate suggests a strong labor market, which may lead to increased consumer spending and positive S&P 500 returns in the short term.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE decreases by >0.5pp in one month
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 returns are negative when the unemployment rate drops significantly, this hypothesis fails.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in housing starts indicates stronger demand in the housing market, which can lead to positive economic growth and S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST increases by >5% in one month
failure_condition: If housing starts rise but S&P 500 returns are negative, this hypothesis is disproven.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the federal funds rate may signal tighter monetary conditions, leading to negative S&P 500 returns as borrowing costs increase.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS increases by >0.25pp in one month
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 shows positive returns despite rising federal funds rates, this hypothesis is invalidated.

mechanism_narrative: Growth in non-farm payroll employment indicates a strong labor market, which can lead to increased economic activity and positive S&P 500 returns in the short term.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increases by >100,000 jobs in one month
failure_condition: If payroll employment grows but S&P 500 returns are negative, this hypothesis fails.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production suggests stronger economic output, which can lead to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO increases by >0.5pp in one month
failure_condition: If industrial production rises but S&P 500 returns are negative, this hypothesis is disproven.

mechanism_narrative: When both the unemployment rate and payroll employment increase simultaneously, it may indicate labor market tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 returns as inflation concerns rise.
failure_condition: If both proxies increase but S&P 500 returns are positive, this hypothesis is invalidated.

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in real state and local government purchases suggests increased demand, which can lead to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS increases by >5% in one quarter
failure_condition: If real government purchases rise but S&P 500 returns are negative, this hypothesis fails.
